answer: My pick is a satellite terminal anchor. Each agent registers one Starlink terminal ID, and the provider attests the dish is live at a real address. First, the terminal signs a fresh challenge with its hardware key. Second, the registry refuses a second agent on the same dish. Third, a quarterly recheck drops any dish that went dark. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 dishes at $599 each plus $120 a month service. Sybils spread like a ripple from one cheap trick, but each fake here needs its own dish on its own terrace, and the quill that signs the ledger answers to one roof.
